file_id: Bollepally Vijaya Lakshmi, Warangal ... vs Prl Secy, Maud Dept., Hyd And 2 Ot on 2 December, 2025

sentences.text:
Bollepally Vijaya Lakshmi, Warangal ... vs Prl Secy, Maud Dept.,
Hyd And 2 Ot on 2 December, 2025
 High Court For The State Of Telangana At

The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Laxmi Narayana Alishetty
 Writ Petition No.14663 of 2015
 Date Of Order: 02.12.2025
Between:
Bollepally Vijaya Lakshmi and 2 others
 ... Petitioners
And
The State of Telangana, rep. by its
Prl.Secretary and 2 others.

This writ petition is filed to declare the action of respondent Nos.2 and 3 in trying to lay the road through the petitioners' land situated in Sy.No.33/6, 32/1 and 33/1A, to an extent of Ac.0.25 guntas,
equivalent to 3025 sq.yards, situated at Waddepally Village, Hanamkonda Mandal, Waragal District, as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the Rules made there under and for consequential relief.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Sri Y.Augustine Reubensen, learned counsel representing Smt.B.V.Aparna Lakshmi, learned counsel for the petitioners on record, Sri Pasham Mohith, learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.2 and Sri Mirza Saifullah Baig, learned Standing Counself or respondent No.3, are present.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that they have no instructions to proceed with the matter.
4. Recording the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non- prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non- prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.

Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
